    meta:
        description = "Detects generic packed .NET payloads often used by Cobalt Strike"

arguments.rule_content:
rule YARA_CobaltStrike_Generic_Packed_DLL {
    meta:
        description = "Detects generic packed Cobalt Strike DLLs - HIGH FP RISK"
        author = "SOC Team"
        confidence = "medium"
        false_positives = ["Packed legitimate .NET applications, Microsoft update modules"]
        remediation = "Whitelist known-good hashes, especially Microsoft-signed binaries"
    strings:
        $a = { 4D 5A } // PE header
        $b = "HttpSendRequest" fullword ascii
        $c = "CryptDecrypt" fullword ascii
        $s = "beacon.dll" nocase
    condition:
        uint16(0) == 0x5A4D and filesize < 2MB and all of them
}

// IMPROVED VERSION BELOW - exclude Microsoft-signed binaries
import "pe"

rule YARA_CobaltStrike_Generic_Packed_DLL_Improved {
    meta:
        description = "Detects generic packed Cobalt Strike DLLs with Microsoft sig exclusion"
        author = "SOC Team"
        confidence = "high"
        false_positives = ["Very low when combined with certificate checks"]
    strings:
        $http = "HttpSendRequest" fullword ascii
        $crypt = "CryptDecrypt" fullword ascii
        $beacon = "beacon" nocase
    condition:
        pe.number_of_signatures > 0 and
        not pe.verify_signature() and
        filesize < 2MB and
        $http and $crypt and $beacon
}

arguments.summary: A post-exploitation activity alert was triggered on host WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42) attributed to user CORP\jsmith. Investigation revealed a phishing compromise via Outlook launching encoded PowerShell, which executed a Cobalt Strike beacon through rundll32 from the Temp directory. The malware established C2 communication over HTTPS to a known-bad IP (198.51.100.23). Evidence of lateral movement via SMB to internal systems and attempted Kerberos TGT requests were observed. Despite sandbox analysis initially classifying the sample as low-risk, SIEM and EDR data confirmed malicious post-exploitation behaviors including credential access, lateral movement, and persistence mechanisms. Containment actions were denied due to policy or targeting issues, indicating a gap in automated response capabilities.

        description = "Detects embedded Cobalt Strike beacon configuration in PE files"

    strings:

        $b = { 6D 68 6F 73 74 00 }   // "mhost" string
        $c = { 75 73 65 72 61 67 65 6E 74 00 } // "useragent"
    condition:
        all of them
}
